definitions.gloss: to talk back; to retort; to answer back
definitions.explanation: To respond defiantly or argumentatively to something someone has said. Implies pushing back against criticism, a scolding, or an accusation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{言|い}い{返|かえ}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not talk back to your parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悔|くや}しかった→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧{言|い}い{返|かえ}せなかった。
examples.english: I was frustrated, but I couldn't say anything back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理不尽|りふじん}→理不尽：07316_rifujin⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、つい{言|い}い{返|かえ}してしまった。
examples.english: My boss said something unreasonable, so I couldn't help talking back.

notes:
USAGE:
{言|い}い{返|かえ}す implies defiance or resistance. It is different from simply replying (⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Often appears in negative contexts: either someone is being told not to talk back, or they wish they could have but didn't.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (consonant stem: ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧). Transitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言|い}い{返|かえ}せない (unable to retort)
- {言|い}い{返|かえ}す⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to be speechless / have no comeback)
- つい{言|い}い{返|かえ}してしまう (to end up talking back despite oneself)

FORMS:
⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return). The compound means "to say something back."
